aries:
♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon has shifted into fiery Leo and joins the Sun in your 5th house, with the Moon moving through Magha and Purva Phalguni. This rekindles your appetite for joy, visibility, and creative risk. Jupiter still strong in Cancer activates your 4th house, so your playful mood is quietly rooted in a deeper desire for emotional security. Mars in late Gemini in your 3rd keeps your mind busy and your words sharp—great for initiative, but you’ll want to steer that fire toward constructive expression.

💼 Career: The 5th-house emphasis favours presenting ideas, pitching concepts, or taking the lead on something that needs personality. This is not a day for hiding behind routine; even if your work is technical, bring a bit more story, colour, or human touch into what you deliver. Mars in your 3rd supports decisive emails, calls, and short negotiations, but avoid impulsive replies—count to three before sending anything emotionally loaded. A small, bold step—speaking up in a meeting, proposing a trial project—can shift how others see your role.

❤️ Love: Romance has a more dramatic, heartfelt tone. If partnered, you may crave attention and genuine appreciation rather than practical help. Tell your partner what actually makes you feel adored instead of hoping they guess. Shared fun—a date, a playful argument that ends in laughter, or revisiting an old inside joke—can reset the emotional atmosphere. If single, your attraction is drawn to confident, expressive people; just make sure sparkle is backed by substance. With Ketu in Leo across your 5th, someone from a past pattern may reappear—notice whether you’re repeating an old script or ready to respond differently.

💰 Money: Financially, this is a day when pleasure spending can creep in through entertainment, children, or creative hobbies. A small treat that genuinely nourishes your spirit is fine; the risk lies in spending to impress or to fill an emotional gap. Jupiter in your 4th gently favours long-term stability—home, savings, security—over short-lived show. If a speculative opportunity comes up, assess whether it’s aligned with your real values or simply exciting in the moment.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself shine, but not in a way that burns through your reserves. Choose one stage where you’ll be fully present and let the rest of the day be simpler than your ego demands.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The applause you’re really seeking today is the feeling of looking at your own actions and thinking, “Yes, that felt like me.”
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon together in Leo light up your 4th house, turning your attention toward home, family, and the private layers of your heart. The Moon moves through royal Magha into sensuous Purva Phalguni, blending ancestral themes with a desire for comfort and ease. Venus, your ruler, glides through Libra in your 6th house, helping you bring more harmony to daily work and health routines. Jupiter in Cancer in your 3rd expands your curiosity and communications, so the day oscillates between inner nesting and outward connection.

💼 Career: This is a productive day for working on matters that affect your sense of security—contracts tied to property or long-term employment, internal planning, or background tasks that quietly stabilise your role. You might feel less inclined to be on display and more drawn to shaping the environment in which you work. Venus in the 6th favours cooperative problem-solving: smoothing over friction with colleagues, refining schedules, or making your workspace more pleasing so you actually enjoy being there. Quick local meetings or messages (Jupiter in the 3rd) can bring a useful tip or offer, especially if you reach out rather than waiting.

❤️ Love: Emotional safety is the main ingredient today. If partnered, there could be a focus on family matters, living arrangements, or how you share private space. A heartfelt talk about what “home” feels like to each of you can reveal subtle needs—privacy, warmth, quiet—that are easy to meet once named. If single, you may be drawn to people who feel familiar or grounded rather than dazzling. Someone connected to your neighbourhood, extended family, or daily commute might become more visible in your awareness.

💰 Money: The 4th-house activation can bring attention to housing costs, repairs, or future plans around property and relocation. This is a sensible day to compare options, clarify terms, or map out a savings track for a home-related goal. Venus in the 6th supports negotiating fair pay for steady work and improving the balance between what you give and what you receive in service. Watch small, habitual expenses tied to comfort—snacks, delivery, impulse décor; refine rather than deprive.

🧘 Advice: Honour your need to feel settled before you stretch outward. When your inner base feels cared for, your natural Taurean steadiness becomes unshakeable again.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The quiet decisions you make about your space today will echo in how safe your heart feels to open tomorrow.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: With the Sun and Moon together in Leo in your 3rd house, your mental world is lit up—ideas, messages, short trips, and sibling dynamics all come to the forefront. The Moon’s passage from Magha into Purva Phalguni adds a theatrical, creative tone to your thinking. Mercury, your ruler, is strong in Virgo in your 4th house, giving you unusual precision around home, family logistics, and emotional organisation. Mars in your own sign (sidereal Gemini) keeps your energy restless but capable of decisive action when focused.

💼 Career: This is an excellent day for communication-heavy work: writing, teaching, presentations, or negotiations. You’re likely to find a richer, more expressive voice than usual, which can help ideas land with greater impact. Mercury in the 4th supports planning from the inside out—drafting strategies, mapping timelines, or organising files and documents that support your stability. If you have calls or meetings, consider infusing one clear creative twist—an unexpected example, a visual, or a story—to keep attention on your message.

❤️ Love: Conversation is your main love language today. If partnered, small gestures—thoughtful texts, a spontaneous coffee together, or talking while you run errands—can feel especially connecting. Be mindful though: with Mars active, your tongue can be quick; steer away from sarcasm that lands harder than you intend. If single, you may meet interesting prospects through your immediate environment: neighbours, classes, online forums, or short trips. Watch whether someone stimulates your mind and also respects your need to move freely.

💰 Money: Financial focus is on micro-decisions—subscriptions, transport, apps, communication tools, and day-to-day purchases. Many small leaks may have more impact than one big expense. Today is good for cancelling what you no longer use, renegotiating a plan, or exploring a side skill you could monetise over time. Mercury in the 4th favours discussing family finances or shared household costs with more clarity and less emotion.

🧘 Advice: Give your thoughts a healthy channel: journal, draft, sketch, or voice-note instead of letting ideas spin only in your head. Expression is your stabiliser today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The words you choose now don’t just describe your life—they begin to steer it.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: After recently crossing your sign, the Moon has moved into Leo and now joins the Sun in your 2nd house of resources, self-worth, and voice. The Moon’s journey through Magha and Purva Phalguni adds a regal, somewhat indulgent flavour—part of you wants to live a little larger. Jupiter still strong in Cancer in your 1st house magnifies your presence and intuition, while Saturn in Pisces in your 9th keeps nudging you toward mature, long-term perspectives.

💼 Career: This is a day to consider how your talents translate into concrete value. You may feel more aware than usual of what you’re being paid versus what you offer, or how respected you feel in your role. The Leo 2nd-house emphasis supports asking for recognition or recalibrating your pricing if you’re self-employed—provided you pair confidence with preparation. Jupiter in your 1st gives you a natural mentor vibe; colleagues may seek your guidance. Share generously but avoid overpromising your time.

❤️ Love: Security and pride intertwine in your relationships. If partnered, topics around money, contributions, and appreciation may arise. You might be craving not just love, but visible acknowledgement of what you bring—emotionally, practically, or financially. Speak about this without tallying points; describe what helps you feel valued. If single, you could be drawn to people who seem successful or self-assured. Check whether they also make space for your emotional depth rather than expecting you to orbit around them.

💰 Money: The Sun–Moon focus in your 2nd house can bring both earning opportunities and spending urges. You may feel inspired to invest in something that boosts your confidence—training, wardrobe, tools, or a small luxury. Balance this by reviewing your income channels: is there a simple adjustment (rate, niche, hours, audience) that would reflect your worth more accurately? Saturn in the 9th recommends aligning money decisions with your ethics and long-term vision rather than short-term flattery.

🧘 Advice: Let your generosity start with yourself. When you treat your own time, skills, and body as valuable, others gradually adjust their treatment to match.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Every choice you make about money today is also a quiet vote for what you believe you deserve.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon meet in your own sign, creating a Leo Amavasya–New Moon flavour in your 1st house of identity and direction. With the Moon moving through Magha into Purva Phalguni, you stand at a reset point around how you carry your authority, creativity, and need for pleasure. Ketu also in Leo adds a karmic, simplifying tone: you’re encouraged to shed old performances that no longer feel true. Jupiter in Cancer in your 12th quietly expands your inner world—dreams, spirituality, and rest.

💼 Career: This is less about immediate results and more about deciding what kind of role you want to play going forward. You may sense an urge to rebrand, change how you show up at work, or redefine what leadership looks like for you. The Leo emphasis gives you courage to start fresh—perhaps by setting new boundaries, choosing projects that excite you, or stepping away from one obligation that drains you. Behind the scenes, Jupiter in the 12th supports strategic retreat: planning in private, clearing old files, or letting one long-standing worry finally go.

❤️ Love: Your heart is in a self-honesty phase. If partnered, you might feel torn between wanting adoration and needing genuine understanding. Conversations that centre on “who I’m becoming” rather than “what you did” can bring you closer. If single, you’re likely to feel more selective, even if others are drawn to your magnetism. Pay attention to which connections allow you to be quieter, more real, not just more impressive; that’s where your energy can root.

💰 Money: Financially, this is a day to clarify intentions rather than chase quick gains. Ask yourself what lifestyle you truly want to sustain and what that implies about income, spending, and work patterns. Ketu in your sign can loosen attachment to status purchases or roles you once thought you needed. Consider one concrete step toward simplification: closing an unnecessary financial commitment, or deciding on a clearer earning focus for the months ahead.

🧘 Advice: Treat today like a personal new chapter. Even one clear inner decision—about how you want to be seen, and what you’ll no longer perform—can quietly redirect the path ahead.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop trying to be impressive and aim to be honest instead, the right kind of spotlight finds you on its own.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: With the Sun and Moon together in Leo in your 12th house, much of today’s action is internal. Old memories, unfinished emotions, or hidden worries may drift closer to the surface. The Moon’s movement from Magha to Purva Phalguni softens this with a longing for rest, beauty, and spiritual comfort. Meanwhile, Mercury—your ruler—stands strong in Virgo in your 1st house, giving you a clear, discriminating mind even as your feelings swirl in the background. Jupiter in Cancer in your 11th supports wise, supportive friendships and long-term aspirations.

💼 Career: Outwardly, this may feel like a quieter workday, but your behind-the-scenes thinking is powerful. Use this time for research, drafting, or quietly spotting which habits at work drain you unnecessarily. Mercury in your 1st sharpens your ability to analyse your own role: what you actually want to be known for, and what busywork you’ve taken on out of guilt or habit. If something feels off in a team or project, your intuition is likely correct—take notes rather than confronting impulsively.

❤️ Love: You may crave emotional privacy or gentle, non-demanding contact. If partnered, you might sense subtle undercurrents—your own or theirs. Instead of probing, try creating a peaceful shared space: a walk, a movie, or simply sitting together without forcing big conversations. When you do speak, Mercury in your sign helps you articulate your inner world with unusual clarity, as long as you avoid self-criticism. If single, dreams, signs, or chance encounters can bring insights about what kind of connection you truly need, beyond mental ideals.

💰 Money: The 12th-house activation can highlight hidden expenses, old subscriptions, or spending that doesn’t clearly support your wellbeing. This is a strong day for quietly cancelling, closing, or renegotiating something that has been nibbling at your resources. Jupiter in the 11th encourages you to think about long-term financial goals linked to community or causes—investments in networks, learning, or collaborations that could grow over time.

🧘 Advice: Give equal respect to your tangible tasks and your subtle impressions. Your nervous system is picking up data your rational mind might dismiss but later confirm.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating your inner life as a distraction, it becomes one of your sharpest instruments of clarity.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon combination in Leo lights up your 11th house of friendships, networks, and future wishes. The Moon’s transit from Magha into Purva Phalguni makes group interactions more heartfelt, creative, and sometimes a bit dramatic. Venus, your ruler, is strong in Libra in your 1st house, heightening your charm and sense of personal aesthetics. Jupiter in Cancer at your 10th house cusp still broadens your professional horizons, though you may be experimenting with which direction truly fits you.

💼 Career: Today’s energy favours collaboration, visibility in communities, and revisiting long-term career goals. You might be invited into a group project, online space, or professional network where your diplomatic skills are appreciated. This is a good time to share something of your work publicly—an update, a portfolio piece, or a thoughtful comment in a professional forum. Venus in your sign enhances your ability to negotiate roles and expectations gracefully; just be careful not to agree to more than you can realistically sustain, even if the opportunity flatters you.

❤️ Love: Social and romantic lines may blur in an enjoyable way. If partnered, spending time with mutual friends or planning something linked to a shared dream can remind you that you’re teammates, not just co-managers of daily life. If single, appealing prospects may appear through your wider circle—events, group chats, digital communities. Notice who consistently supports and celebrates you rather than just showing up when the mood is high; that’s where emotional safety can grow.

💰 Money: The 11th house is also connected with gains from career and networks. You might receive news about payments, bonuses, or referrals through others, or see more clearly how a particular circle influences your earning potential. Consider whether your financial goals are actually up to date with who you’ve become. Venus in the 1st can tempt you toward self-presentation spending; choose upgrades that genuinely match your current path instead of chasing every trend.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself enjoy being connected, but keep one eye on the long arc of where these connections lead. You’re curating not just friends, but the ecosystem around your future.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The rooms you walk into now—online and offline—quietly teach people how to picture your future role in their world.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon pairing in Leo crowns your chart in the 10th house, bringing your public role, reputation, and responsibilities into sharp focus. The Moon’s move from Magha to Purva Phalguni adds both dignity and a desire for more joy in your work. Mars, your traditional ruler, is in late Gemini in your 8th house, keeping deeper themes—shared resources, psychological patterns, and unspoken power dynamics—in play. Jupiter in Cancer in your 9th continues to widen your worldview.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for professional visibility. You may be called to take charge, present something, or make a key decision. The Leo emphasis asks: are you proud of the way you’re showing up? If not, this New Moon flavour gives you room to adjust—by claiming more leadership where you’ve been holding back, or by gently stepping away from a role that no longer aligns with your integrity. Mars in the 8th supports focused work on complex matters like budgets, contracts, or sensitive negotiations; just keep an eye on intensity so you don’t push others faster than they can follow.

❤️ Love: You may carry some of your professional intensity into your relationships, for better or worse. If partnered, they might see you wrestling with ambition, duty, or visibility; let them into the emotional side of that rather than just the stress. Sharing hopes and fears about your career path can deepen trust. If single, you may feel drawn to people you meet through work or through higher-learning and spiritual spaces. Watch whether attraction is mixed with power dynamics—teacher–student, boss–subordinate—and consider whether that truly serves you.

💰 Money: With Mars in the 8th, shared finances, investments, and debts may require attention. Today is useful for clarifying terms, spotting where you carry more than your share, or setting healthier limits around lending, borrowing, or emotional dependence linked to money. The Leo 10th-house energy suggests that how you handle these matters affects your reputation; choose transparency and fairness even if it feels vulnerable.

🧘 Advice: Let your ambition be guided by depth, not just applause. You’re at your best when your outer achievements are a true reflection of your inner evolution.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you hold power today—at work and in money—sets the tone for the kind of respect you’ll receive later.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Sun and Moon joining in Leo energise your 9th house of belief, learning, travel, and purpose. The Moon’s shift from Magha into Purva Phalguni brings both reverence for where you come from and a playful hunger for new experiences. Jupiter, your ruler, continues in Cancer in your 8th house, urging deep emotional and financial honesty. Saturn in Pisces in your 4th keeps reshaping your sense of what “home” really means.

💼 Career: Big-picture thinking is strongly supported today. You’re well-placed to explore new fields, courses, or long-term projects that broaden your horizons. This could be a day when an idea about teaching, publishing, or working with international or cross-cultural themes takes on more concrete form. Discussions with mentors, advisors, or wise peers can yield valuable perspective. With Jupiter in the 8th, pay attention to how your deeper psychological patterns—around trust, risk, and dependence—affect your professional choices.

❤️ Love: You’re drawn toward relationships that feel expansive rather than confining. If partnered, conversations about future plans, shared adventures, or personal growth paths can feel especially alive. You may need more philosophical or spiritual connection now, not just practical coordination. If single, you might connect with someone from a different background, or through study, travel planning, or spiritual communities. Notice whether the relationship helps you be more honest with yourself, not just more entertained.

💰 Money: With Jupiter in the 8th and the 9th house lit, financial matters are tied to beliefs and long-term freedom. You might reassess loans, investments, or shared expenses, asking whether they still support your values. This is a good day to seek expert advice if you’ve been avoiding a complex money issue; you’re more open to learning and less likely to cling to old assumptions. Saturn in the 4th reminds you that a solid base—reasonable housing costs, sustainable family responsibilities—is key to any grand plan.

🧘 Advice: Let curiosity lead, but make sure you’re not using constant searching to avoid sitting with what’s already here. Wisdom comes from integrating experiences, not just collecting them.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The belief you quietly revise today can change the kinds of doors you even think to knock on tomorrow.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon conjunction in Leo activates your 8th house, drawing attention to intimacy, shared resources, deeper emotions, and the parts of life you cannot control alone. The Moon’s transit from Magha into Purva Phalguni makes this process both serious and potentially healing; you may crave loyalty and warmth in your closest bonds. Saturn, your ruler, is in Pisces in your 3rd, teaching you disciplined communication, while Jupiter in Cancer in your 7th expands the importance of key partnerships.

💼 Career: Hidden layers of work—budgets, contracts, trust dynamics—may come into focus. This is a good day for reviewing agreements, clarifying expectations with collaborators, or dealing with sensitive information that requires discretion. With Jupiter in the 7th, certain allies or clients can be especially supportive; don’t hesitate to ask direct questions or request more transparent terms. Saturn in your 3rd encourages you to choose your words with care—firm, clear, and measured rather than blunt.

❤️ Love: Emotional depth is highlighted. If partnered, themes like trust, vulnerability, and how you share power or responsibilities may surface. These conversations can feel intense but also bonding if approached gently. You might recognise an old fear or pattern that you’re ready to outgrow. If single, you may feel drawn to people with complexity—those who’ve been through things and emerged wiser. Take your time; the 8th house asks for slow, deliberate revealing rather than instant merging.

💰 Money: Financially, joint matters take precedence: shared accounts, loans, inheritances, or even unspoken expectations about who pays for what. Today is favourable for putting things in writing, adjusting unequal arrangements, or simply becoming more aware of where your energy goes in exchange for financial stability. The Leo flavour adds a question of pride—are you afraid to ask for help or to renegotiate because you don’t want to appear weak? True strength lies in honest assessment, not silent endurance.

🧘 Advice: When you feel tension around control, pause and distinguish between what is truly yours to manage and what must be co-created or released.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The courage to look at the difficult truths now becomes the quiet backbone of your future security.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: With the Sun and Moon uniting in Leo directly opposite your sign, your 7th house of partnerships, clients, and one-to-one dynamics is strongly highlighted. The Moon’s passage from Magha into Purva Phalguni makes interactions warmer, sometimes more dramatic, but also ripe for honest connection. Saturn, your traditional ruler, continues its steady work in Pisces in your 2nd house, reshaping your relationship with income, values, and self-worth. Jupiter in Cancer in your 6th supports growth through daily service and skill-building.

💼 Career: Today is all about how you collaborate. Key people—bosses, clients, colleagues, or business partners—may demand more of your time, attention, or decision-making. The Leo emphasis in your 7th suggests that balanced leadership is needed: neither over-accommodating nor rigidly detached. You’re invited to recognise where a partnership could be more equal and to state your needs clearly. Jupiter in the 6th favours improving workflows and health at work, possibly through better division of tasks or clearer agreements.

❤️ Love: Relationship mirrors are strong now. If partnered, you may see more vividly how your habits affect the bond—both your strengths and your blind spots. This is a potent day for heartfelt, face-to-face conversation about what each of you needs to feel seen and respected. If single, you might encounter someone confident and expressive who challenges your usual cool distance. Pay attention to how you feel in your body around them: tense, or gently more alive?

💰 Money: Saturn in the 2nd keeps financial realism at the forefront. The 7th-house activation suggests that negotiations, shared costs, or contracts may be on the table. Aim for arrangements that honour your boundaries and reflect your actual contributions rather than vague goodwill. This is also a good day to consider whether your current rates, salary, or business model match the level of responsibility you carry in partnerships.

🧘 Advice: See other people not as obstacles or saviours, but as co-authors in certain chapters of your life story. You’re allowed to edit the cast list when the roles no longer fit.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you handle one important relationship today can quietly reset the pattern for many others.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Sun–Moon conjunction in Leo activates your 6th house of work, health, and daily rhythms. The Moon’s move from Magha into Purva Phalguni colours routines with a desire for more warmth and enjoyment, not just duty. Jupiter, your traditional ruler, remains in Cancer in your 5th house, enhancing creativity, affection, and connection with children or passion projects. Saturn in your own sign Pisces in the 1st continues to refine your identity through responsibility and boundaries.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for reordering your daily life so it actually supports your emerging self. You may feel a push to take your time management, wellbeing, and skill development more seriously. The Leo flavour in the 6th suggests that you’re ready to bring more pride and heart into even ordinary tasks—perhaps by taking ownership of a specific area, improving quality, or setting a higher standard for yourself in a sustainable way. Jupiter in the 5th favours weaving creativity into work, especially if you’re in teaching, design, caregiving, or any field requiring empathy.

❤️ Love: Practical matters intersect with romance. If partnered, you may talk about schedules, chores, or lifestyle changes that could make both of you feel more supported. Approached with playfulness rather than blame, these conversations can actually deepen affection. If single, potential connections may be found in work contexts, wellness spaces, or through shared responsibilities. Notice who respects your time and energy as much as your feelings.

💰 Money: The 6th house connects finances to habits and service. Today is excellent for reviewing how your everyday choices—diet, sleep, focus, consistency—affect your earning capacity. Small improvements can compound over time. You might also consider modest investments in tools or training that enhance both your competence and enjoyment of work. Saturn in your 1st reminds you not to overextend; make changes you can realistically maintain, not heroic but brief efforts.

🧘 Advice: Bring kindness into structure. When you design your routines to care for the human you actually are, not the ideal you imagine, real change becomes possible.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you handle the “ordinary” today is quietly teaching life how ready you are for the extraordinary.
